reasoning: This session targets your lactate clearance limiter by working right around the transition from aerobic to anaerobic metabolism. Your last ride showed good endurance at a lower effort, but to handle the 6% avg grade of the Alpine Loop's main climb, we need to improve fatigue resistance during higher exertion. Regularly tackling these over-unders will strengthen your aerobic base and better prepare you for the duration and power demands of the climb.

suggested_sets.name: Main Set
suggested_sets.description: 3x12-minute sets of over-unders: 3 min at 242-256W, 3 min at 201-218W, 3 min at 242-256W, 3 min at 201-218W. 3 min recovery between sets.

weekly_focus: This week: progressive loading — keep attacking the lactate clearance gap.
